title: Improve Telegram #3 match-alert quality: human-readable match result, image attachment (better crop), confidence + runner-ups
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-14, post alert-quality review of c3762af1)
plan_section: v1 match-alert port (farm-surveillance-refactor/telegram_formatter/match_telegram.py + no_match_telegram.py) + vehicle/animal better_crop schema additions
trigger: Operator 2026-09-14 (verbatim): 'Okay, I want you to do number one, and in addition for Telegram 3, it needs to send an image. So, I like it to send the better of the two crops. And I'm not sure which the better of the two crops is. When we did the Vision Model 2 run, did we, in its structured output, tell us which was the higher quality crop? If so, then that's the one that can be done for three. If not, maybe we come up with a different idea. But you need to have an image along with a telegram alert, or else it's much harder to know what the words are talking about.' Three concrete gaps surfaced on alert c3762af1 (OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER, 2026-09-14T15:35:31Z): (1) TG#3 hardcodes 'unrecognized vehicle' even for person alerts — operator saw a person-classified alert labeled as a vehicle. (2) TG#3 'Recognized' line uses vm2_result.license_plate, which VM2 rarely returns, so matched alerts show only 'Status: recognized vehicle' with zero identification. (3) TG#3 sends no image, so the operator has no visual confirmation of what was matched or rejected.
background: v1 (farm-surveillance-refactor) has a mature match-alert pipeline: (a) build_match_telegram_body shows 'Matched: <label>' + ID/Owner/Color/Make-Model + Confidence + Gap + top-2 Runner-ups; (b) build_no_match_telegram_body shows 'Reason' + 'Top candidates:' with per-dimension breakdown + thresholds; (c) both call send_photo_group with crop_paths. v2 telegram_formatter/match_alert.py is 82 lines, sends no photo, only references vm2_result.license_plate. Vehicle + animal schemas in v2 lack a 'better_crop' field; person schema already has it (enum crop_a|crop_b|neither). score_top_n / top-3 candidates already implemented in vehicle_matcher/match.py — just not surfaced in TG#3. This PRD ports v1's match-alert layout + adds better_crop to vehicle/animal schemas so TG#3 can attach the right crop.

(c) TG#3 send_photo with the chosen crop, falling back to crop_a when 'neither' or field absent. (d) TG#3 body shows matched label (or top candidates if no-match) with confidence + runner-ups. (e) Person path uses person label/owner, not 'vehicle'. (f) Full pytest green. (g) All four stories committed on main with US-044 in the message. Working tree clean.

stories.notes: v1 build_match_telegram_body at farm-surveillance-refactor/telegram_formatter/match_telegram.py:102 is the reference. Slimmed layout per Phase 6B.121: Matched: <label>; primary fields block (ID/Owner/Color/Make-Model/Body); Confidence: <score> (gap: <gap>); Runner-ups: #1 <kv>: <score> / #2 <kv>: <score>; captured_at footer. Score formatting: if score is between 0 and 1, show as 0.85; else show as 8.5 (v2's MATCH_MIN_SCORE=3.0 implies internal scoring is on a higher scale). match_vehicle currently returns just the matched kv; expose score + all_scores list as a sibling field so formatter can render runner-ups without re-running the scorer.
